title: study vlog | midterm exams, library studying, productive days, ramen, uni life
description:
In this study vlog, I am preparing for my midterm exams on top of crunching down assignments. I try not to eat instant ramen too much but this time it's excused. I also cooked a quick kimchi fried rice which tasted great after my test. I'm going to continue spamming flashcards now.

I was in a crazy rush to get this video out so it might be a little chopped, I hope you enjoyed though :]

Thank you so much for watching and take care!
